Description.header: Insert a chunk of a document into persistent storage
Description.body: The chunk will be attached to an existing document described by unique 'doc_id', which was returned previously by the API `put_doc`. The parameter `data` contains encoded bytes which encoding schema must be determined by the parameter `metadata`. If nothing is set, the type of `data` is considered as a string-type. If the insertion is successful, the API call returns unique id of the inserted chunk
